content.text: The visible suite now passes (1 passed). I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: in `TTLCache._expired`, the comparison went from `self.clock() - ts > self.ttl` to `>=`. The cause was that an entry was still considered live when its age was exactly equal to the TTL, so `get` returned the value at `t = 10.0` for a 10.0 TTL. Because `put` and `get` both go through `_expired`, the boundary is now consistent across capacity purging and lookups.
